outcome: Association between T. gondii infection and sociodemographic, clinical, and behavioral characteristics
cohort: 408 healthy blood donors in Hermosillo city, Mexico, with a mean age of 31.77 ± 9.52 years (range 18-60 years old)
finding: The seroprevalence of T. gondii infection in blood donors in Sonora, Mexico was found to be 13.5%, and infection was associated with older age and tobacco use.
